phase_0.boundary_condition: The set of natural numbers containing only the unity element

VINIT.justification: The state preceding the definition of the unit

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary of the single-element system

AFWD.justification: The mapping of the unit to itself

AREV.justification: The inverse mapping within the unit set

CLINK.justification: The chaining of the unit to itself

IMSCRIB.justification: The unit is identical to itself

FSPLIT.justification: The unit branches into two identical potential states

FFUSE.justification: The two potential states collapse back into the unit

EVALT.justification: The positive verification of the unit

ENGAGR.justification: The unit held as both present and absent

IFIX.justification: The permanent record of the unit definition

phase_3.void_description: The state of non-existence before the unit is defined
phase_3.true_description: The state where the unit is present and verified
phase_3.false_description: The state where the unit is absent
phase_3.both_description: The state where the unit is simultaneously present and absent

steps.domain_action: Genesis of the unit from the empty set
Branching the unit into two potential paths
Affirming the presence of the unit on the primary path
Negating the presence of the unit on the secondary path
Recombining the paths to recover the unit
Recording the unit as a permanent axiom
Closing the system at the unity boundary

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The system is a closed identity mapping with no information loss
